# Echo branding

These four transparent PNG files are the user's original uploads from Curved Shape Design.zip, copied without resizing, cropping, recoloring or redrawing.

- Echo_Darktheme.png: full wordmark for the website's dark appearance.
- Echo_Lighttheme.png: full wordmark for the website's light appearance.
- Logo_Darktheme.png: square symbol for dark surfaces.
- Logo_Lighttheme.png: square symbol for light surfaces; always used for the favicon, Apple touch icon and web-app icon.

Email headers use the full light wordmark on their default light surface and the full dark wordmark when a supporting mail client requests dark appearance. All images use public GitHub Pages URLs so recipients do not need access to the private site or Google Sheet.
